passage.label: By star descends; companion not strayed nor erred; not speak inclination; not but revelation revealed; taught intense strength; soundness rose true form; higher horizon; approached descended; distance two bow lengths nearer; revealed Servant what revealed; heart not lie saw; dispute over saw; certainly saw another descent; Lote Tree Utmost Boundary; near Garden Refuge; covered Lote Tree covered; sight not swerve nor transgress limit; certainly saw greatest signs Lord

arabicExcerpts.text: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ

mainSubject.label: Oath by the descending star grounding the Prophet's freedom from straying and error; his speech identified as revelation rather than inclination, taught by one intense in strength who rose to his true form in the higher horizon, approached and descended to within two bow-lengths or nearer, revealing to His Servant what he revealed; the heart did not lie about what it saw, challenging dispute over the vision; a second descent confirmed at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary near the Garden of Refuge, when something covered the tree; the Prophet's sight neither swerved nor transgressed its limit, having seen the greatest signs of his Lord

subordinateSubjects.label: Oath by the star when it descends
Your companion has not strayed nor erred
He does not speak from his own inclination
It is nothing but a revelation revealed
Taught to him by one intense in strength
One of soundness who rose to his true form
While he was in the higher part of the horizon
At a distance of two bow-lengths or nearer
And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed
The heart did not lie about what it saw
Will you then dispute with him over what he saw
He certainly saw him in another descent
At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary
Near it is the Garden of Refuge
When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered it
The sight did not swerve nor transgress its limit
He certainly saw the greatest signs of his Lord

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the greatest-signs affirmation (18) before the idol-challenge block opens (19); P2 ends with the self-purification prohibition (32) before the Musa-Ibrahim scripture reminders begin (33); P3 runs through the ethical axioms, divine attributes and destruction catalogue closing with the favors question (33-55); P4 covers the warner-identity, Approaching Day, their misplaced wonder and the closing prostration command (56-62).
